# Athalla Arli — Software Engineer Portfolio

Athalla Arli is a Software Engineer based in Bandung, Indonesia. Builds and integrates backend APIs for CMS and POS systems, plus mobile app integration, with Next.js, React, .NET, Laravel, PHP, Java, and PostgreSQL.

## Services
- Web App & SaaS Development
- POS System Development & Integration
- CMS Development & Integration
- Backend API Development
- Mobile App Integration
- UI/UX Design
- Workflow Automation Setup
